intro: CAVA Strawberry Sesame dressing brings a unique sweet and savory fusion to your bowl or pita. This signature dressing combines fresh strawberry puree with nutty sesame oil and tangy rice vinegar, creating a light yet flavorful option at just 60 calories. Available on the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings), it complements the fresh Mediterranean ingredients found throughout the [full CAVA menu](/). Perfect for those seeking a distinctive flavor profile.
priceCalories: Strawberry Sesame dressing is included with your order at no extra charge, with up to 2 dressings per bowl or pita. At only 60 calories per serving, it offers a guilt-free way to enhance your meal. With 5g of fat, 3g of carbs, and 1g of protein, this dressing provides balanced nutrition without overwhelming your customized creation from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) or [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains).
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Strawberry Sesame apart is its unexpected flavor combination that balances fruit sweetness with Asian-inspired ingredients. The strawberry puree provides natural sweetness without added sugars, while sesame oil adds depth and richness. Rice vinegar brings brightness and acidity, creating a perfectly balanced dressing that stands out among typical Mediterranean options. This innovative fusion showcases CAVA's commitment to creative, globally-inspired flavors.
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Strawberry Sesame contains 60 calories, making it one of the lighter dressing options. The nutritional breakdown includes 5g of fat from sesame oil, 3g of carbohydrates from strawberry puree, and 1g of protein. This balanced profile works well for various dietary goals. For detailed nutritional information across all menu items, visit the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to customize your perfect meal.
whatsInside: Strawberry Sesame features three simple, quality ingredients: fresh strawberry puree for natural sweetness, toasted sesame oil for nutty richness, and rice vinegar for tangy brightness. This minimalist approach ensures clean flavors without artificial additives or preservatives. The strawberry puree provides authentic fruit flavor, while sesame oil contributes healthy fats and distinctive taste. Rice vinegar ties everything together with its mild acidity.
tasteLike: The flavor profile offers an initial burst of sweet strawberry followed by nutty sesame undertones and a tangy vinegar finish. It tastes bright and refreshing, not overly sweet or heavy. The sesame oil provides a subtle toasted quality that complements the fruit, while rice vinegar adds a clean acidity that prevents the dressing from being cloying. The overall experience is light, balanced, and uniquely satisfying.
customize: Strawberry Sesame pairs beautifully with greens-based bowls from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls). Try it over SuperGreens or RomaineCrispy for maximum freshness. It complements grilled chicken, falafel, or roasted vegetables particularly well. Consider adding it to pitas from the [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) for a sweet-savory contrast. Mix with another dressing like Lemon Herb Tahini for added complexity and creaminess.
pairsWell: This dressing works exceptionally well with Garlic Dressing, Greek Vinaigrette, Lemon Herb Tahini, and Hot Harissa Vinaigrette. The strawberry sweetness balances spicy harissa perfectly, while complementing the herbaceous notes of Greek Vinaigrette. Try it with grilled proteins, fresh vegetables, and grain bases. It enhances the flavors of feta cheese, cucumbers, tomatoes, and cabbage slaw. The versatility makes it suitable for various combinations.
healthyChoice: At 60 calories per serving, Strawberry Sesame is a nutritious choice for health-conscious diners. The sesame oil provides beneficial unsaturated fats, while strawberry puree offers natural vitamins and antioxidants. With minimal carbohydrates and no added sugars, it fits various dietary plans. The simple ingredient list makes it suitable for those avoiding processed foods. Check the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for specific dietary considerations.
howToOrder: When building your bowl or pita at CAVA, simply request Strawberry Sesame dressing after selecting your base, protein, and toppings. You can choose up to 2 dressings at no additional cost, so consider pairing it with another complementary option. Ask for it on the side if you prefer controlling the amount. Available at all [CAVA Locations](/locations), it can be drizzled over or mixed throughout your creation.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Greek Vinaigrette at 130 calories and Garlic Dressing at 180 calories, Strawberry Sesame offers a lighter option at just 60 calories. While Lemon Herb Tahini and Hot Harissa Vinaigrette match its calorie count at 70 calories, Strawberry Sesame provides unique fruity sweetness. Unlike creamy dressings, its vinegar base keeps it refreshing. The distinctive flavor profile sets it apart from traditional Mediterranean dressings.
whoShouldTry: Strawberry Sesame appeals to adventurous eaters seeking unique flavor combinations beyond traditional options. Those watching calories will appreciate its light profile, while health-conscious diners value the simple, natural ingredients. It suits anyone who enjoys sweet and savory contrasts or Asian-fusion flavors. Vegetarians and those following plant-based diets will find it complements their choices perfectly. Anyone tired of standard vinaigrettes should explore this innovative option.
worthTrying: Absolutely worth trying for its unique flavor profile and versatility across the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings). The unexpected strawberry-sesame combination delivers a refreshing change from typical Mediterranean dressings while maintaining CAVA's commitment to quality ingredients. At no extra cost and only 60 calories, there is minimal risk and maximum reward. Its ability to enhance various proteins and vegetables makes it a valuable addition to your CAVA experience.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Strawberry Sesame dressing?
faqs.a: CAVA Strawberry Sesame dressing contains 60 calories per serving, making it one of the lighter dressing options available. It includes 5g of fat, 3g of carbohydrates, and 1g of protein.

faqs.q: What ingredients are in Strawberry Sesame dressing?
faqs.a: Strawberry Sesame dressing contains three main ingredients: strawberry puree for natural sweetness, sesame oil for nutty richness, and rice vinegar for tangy acidity. This simple combination creates a unique sweet and savory flavor profile.

faqs.q: Is Strawberry Sesame dressing included with my order?
faqs.a: Yes, Strawberry Sesame dressing is included with your CAVA order at no additional charge. You can select up to 2 dressings per bowl or pita without any extra cost.

faqs.q: What does Strawberry Sesame dressing taste like?
faqs.a: Strawberry Sesame tastes sweet and savory with bright strawberry notes upfront, followed by nutty sesame undertones and a tangy vinegar finish. The flavor is light, refreshing, and well-balanced without being overly sweet or heavy.

faqs.q: Which proteins pair best with Strawberry Sesame dressing?
faqs.a: Strawberry Sesame pairs excellently with grilled chicken, falafel, roasted vegetables, and all CAVA protein options. The sweet-savory profile complements both mild and bold flavors, making it versatile for various combinations from the menu.
